pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	pdf_bytesBytes, pdf_bytesBytesErr := os.ReadFile(`pdf/password_protected.pdf`)
	if pdf_bytesBytesErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("read fixture pdf/password_protected.pdf: %v", pdf_bytesBytesErr))
	}
	passwordVal := `xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879`
	_, err := xberg.PdfPageCount(pdf_bytesBytes, &passwordVal)
	var typedError xberg.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
